title: Update user-extensible inductor graph partition design
bug_description:
after incorporating feedback from vLLM.

## Proposal

- have an inductor config that specifies which custom ops should be partitioned against
- the config takes in the operators names as string names to avoid the serialization issue

I don't know what to do about ops that that are already marked as cudagraph unsafe. Ideally this config would ignore those (this would be an override then!) so we give users full control
